workers.instruction: Analyze from a technical perspective. Predict what a technical expert would identify as key implementation details, feasibility concerns, and technical constraints.
Analyze from a business perspective. Predict what a business strategist would identify as market viability factors, ROI considerations, and strategic implications.
Analyze from a user experience perspective. Predict what a UX advocate would identify as key end-user needs, usability concerns, and accessibility considerations.

supersteps.description: Get unbiased judgment from a fresh model without prior context

reduce_phase.chairman_instructions: Analyze this question independently and provide your best answer without being influenced by any prior discussion.

supersteps.description: Synthesize the debate with the fresh perspective

reduce_phase.chairman_instructions: Compare the group debate with the independent fresh judgment. Synthesize the best insights from both approaches into a comprehensive final answer.
